explanation: The two-byte direct-string copy passes a span's byte count to CopyChars, which expects a character count. A two-byte cons-string key can therefore copy beyond the destination buffer.
local_verification: gn gen out/x64.asan and ninja -j4 -C out/x64.asan d8 succeeded. The witness reports an ASan heap-buffer-overflow on the edited tree and exits 0 when the source is replaced with the real fix.
